name: form
title: Form 表单（Formsnap）
description: 基于 Formsnap 与 sveltekit-superforms 的表单组件，按字段管理状态与校验错误。

whenToUse: SvelteKit 中用 sveltekit-superforms 与 Zod 等做客户端和服务端校验的表单

whenNotToUse.case: 不使用 superforms，只需字段布局与错误展示

accessibility: Form.Control 根据字段状态为控件设置 id、aria-describedby、aria-invalid
错误用 Form.FieldErrors 显示，说明用 Form.Description
responsive: 布局由内部控件决定，窄屏下单列排列

files.content:
# Form 设计规范

- 用于基于 Formsnap 和 sveltekit-superforms 的表单：校验 schema 写在 superforms 中，每个字段用 `Form.Field {form} name="…"` 绑定，不要自己维护错误状态。
- 控件放进 `Form.Control` 的 `{#snippet children({ props })}`，并把 `props` 展开到控件上（`<Input {...props} />`），这样 `id`、`name`、`aria-invalid` 和说明文字关联会自动生成；不要自己写这些属性。
- 标签用 `Form.Label`（放在 Control 里），说明用 `Form.Description`，错误用 `Form.FieldErrors`；一组字段用 `Form.Fieldset` + `Form.Legend`。
- 提交按钮用 `Form.Button`（等同 `type="submit"` 的 Button），一个表单只有一个主提交按钮；提交期间禁用并显示进度。
- 不使用 superforms 的简单表单不需要 Form，直接用 Field 组件。

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button, type ButtonProps } from "$UI$/button/index.js";

	let { ref = $bindable(null), ...restProps }: ButtonProps = $props();
</script>

<Button bind:ref type="submit" {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import * as FormPrimitive from "formsnap";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<FormPrimitive.DescriptionProps> = $props();
</script>

<FormPrimitive.Description
	bind:ref
	data-slot="form-description"
	class={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

{#snippet children({ constraints, errors, tainted, value })}
{@render childrenProp?.({ constraints, errors, tainted, value: value as T[U] })}
{/snippet}

{#snippet children({ errors, errorProps })} {#if childrenProp} {@render childrenProp({ errors, errorProps })} {:else} {#each errors as error (error)}
{error}
{/each} {/if} {/snippet}

{#snippet children({ constraints, errors, tainted, value })}
{@render childrenProp?.({ constraints, errors, tainted, value: value as T[U] })}
{/snippet}

<script lang="ts" generics="T extends Record<string, unknown>, U extends FormPath<T>">
	import * as FormPrimitive from "formsnap";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { FormPath } from "sveltekit-superforms";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		form,
		name,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<FormPrimitive.FieldsetProps<T, U>> = $props();
</script>

<FormPrimitive.Fieldset bind:ref {form} {name} class={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import * as FormPrimitive from "formsnap";
	import { Label } from "$UI$/label/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		children,
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<FormPrimitive.LabelProps> = $props();
</script>

<FormPrimitive.Label {...restProps} bind:ref>
	{#snippet child({ props })}
		<Label
			{...props}
			data-slot="form-label"
			class={cn("data-[fs-error]:text-destructive", className)}
		>
			{@render children?.()}
		</Label>
	{/snippet}
</FormPrimitive.Label>

<script lang="ts">
	import * as FormPrimitive from "formsnap";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<FormPrimitive.LegendProps> = $props();
</script>

<FormPrimitive.Legend
	bind:ref
	class={cn("text-sm leading-none font-medium data-[fs-error]:text-destructive", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>
